sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Telford Town on Saturday 7 November for a 15:00 kick-off. Despite two recent league losses, Sandbach remain top of the table with 31 points from 15 games. They face a Telford side in severe struggles at the foot of the division with just one win all season, making this a favorable fixture for the leaders to respond.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host AFC Bridgnorth in an intriguing clash between two in-form sides, with Stafford on a mixed run and Bridgnorth having won their last league match. Eccleshall welcome New Mills in a fixture between third and eighth place; Eccleshall have won three of their last six league games and look well-positioned in the promotion race. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and on excellent form with five wins in their last six, host struggling Foley Meir on Wednesday 11 November at 20:00. Bilston Town (sixth) travel to Alsager Town (18th) on Wednesday 11 November at 19:45; Bilston have recovered from a recent loss with five consecutive league wins and face one of the division's weakest sides. Crewe host Dawley Town on Saturday, with Crewe having won their last outing despite a poor run overall. Barnton, a promotion contender in seventh place on 25 points, host bottom-half side Market Drayton Town on Saturday. Allscott Heath welcome Wednesfield Community on Saturday in a mid-table fixture where Allscott are on five consecutive league wins. Brereton Social host Shawbury United on Saturday in a clash between two struggling sides both near the bottom. Widnes Town, second from bottom with just one win all season, face Bridgnorth away on Tuesday 10 November at 19:45 in a fixture between a title challenger and a relegation-form team.
